competences.description: Attacks with magical powers and inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to inflict damage that's proportionate to the enemy's MAX HP and stuns them with a 40% chance. If the target is not stunned after attacking, decreases the Attack Bar of the target by 50% with a 100% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

effets.note: If enemy is immune to stun

competences.description: Removes a harmful effect, except inability effects, on all allies each turn and the allies will recover their HP by 5% for each harmful effect removed. In addition, your Attack Bar increases by 15% for each harmful effect remaining on the ally after attacking each turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: Does not cleanse inability effects (Stun, Freeze, etc)
On cleanse, per harmful effect removed

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: For every removed harmful effect on an ally
